# RUN-1 captures (generated by `sandbox/visual/run1/tools/run1_capture.cjs`, headless Chrome GPU path, 10 Oct 2026)

All frames come from the viewer `sandbox/visual/run1.html` at the commit that adds this file, with deterministic times. The yellow label on each frame is the time in seconds since the run started, plus **RUN-1's** gait phase (shown on the V1 frames too, for timing).

| file | what |
|---|---|
| 01_side_RUN1_5.5.png | RUN-1, 5.5 m/s, left-side close view, one stride (8 frames) |
| 02_side_V1_5.5.png | Locomotion V1 (V1.3 presentation, unmodified `ofActorTick`), the same mover and times |
| 03_game_zoom4_RUN1_vs_V1.png | the CAMERA_V1 gameplay camera at 4× (subject centred by a clip-space offset; the camera pose is unchanged). RUN-1 is on the near lane, V1 on the far lane |
| 04_game_zoom1_RUN1_vs_V1.png | the same at true gameplay scale (1×), cropped around the runners |
| 05_front_RUN1_5.5.png | RUN-1 running toward the camera, front close view |
| 06_side_RUN1_ramp_3_7.8_3.png | RUN-1 through the 3.0 → 7.8 → 3.0 m/s ramp, one frame every 0.5 s |
| 07_rear_RUN1_5.5.png | RUN-1 running toward the camera, rear close view (the recovering heel passes outside the stance leg after iteration 11) |
| 08_game_zoom2.5_diagonal_RUN1_vs_V1.png | the gameplay camera at 2.5×, diagonal run; RUN-1 near, V1 far |

| 09_side_RUN1_3.0.png / 09_side_RUN1_7.8.png | RUN-1 jog (3.0 m/s) and sprint (7.8 m/s), one stride each, side view |
| 10_motion_paths_RUN1_vs_V1_5.5.png | motion paths relative to the pelvis over one stride (ankle, toe tip, knee, wrist, head), side and front, RUN-1 vs V1 (`tools/run1_paths.cjs`) |

All sheets were recaptured at 06:09 (10 Oct) after iterations 7 – 15. Earlier versions are in Git history (`e2dfc0a8`, `41110a54`).
